ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure has physical pictures of four labeled components, with labels in order A, B, C, D. A looks like a small black block-shaped component; B is a small black packaged component, with three relatively long pins extending below; C is a device with a metal appearance and marked with pin letters K, G, A; D is a rectangular chip component marked R100. Reasoning: The common physical feature of a triode/transistor is a small black package with three pins. The component under label B in the figure has a black body and exactly three long pins, matching the transistor shape; the appearances of A, C, and D do not match this common transistor package. Therefore B should be selected.

planner_metadata.knowledge_role: A triode/transistor component in basic electronics is commonly recognized physically as a small black package with three leads corresponding to its three terminals.
